narrative.northStar: Printed by hand, built with care.
narrative.overview:
The site looks like it came off a risograph: warm paper, a dark plum ink plus three bright spot inks, visible grain, slightly misregistered type, halftone dot shadows, and bright shapes that blend where they overlap. It keeps v1's sticker DNA (thick outlines, round shapes, a little tilt) and prints it.

Underneath, everything is systematic: tokenized, accessible, CMS-driven. That tension is the brand. Delight on the surface, rigor underneath. The site should prove "design roots, developer instincts" rather than claim it.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, one dark ink (Plum) and three spot inks (Lime, Orchid, Amber), each with a job
Thick plum outlines and round shapes, with a little hand-placed tilt
Shrikhand for headings and stickers; Work Sans for everything else
Dots sit still, solid ink moves: halftone dots mean 'container', a solid offset shadow means 'click me'
Riso texture is a layer: grain, ghost misregistration and overprints, never behind or under text
Delight on the surface, rigor underneath: tokenized, accessible, CMS-driven

rules.name: The Shadow Rule
rules.body: Dots sit still. Solid ink moves. Interactive elements get a solid, zero-blur offset shadow and lift on hover; static containers get a halftone dot layer behind an opaque box; stickers and the nav get nothing.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are paper or surface. Spot inks are fills inside outlined shapes, never full-bleed section bands.

rules.name: The Photo Rule
rules.body: Photos and project screenshots are always shown in natural color. No duotone for now.

rules.name: The Ghost
rules.body: Display, page titles, section titles and prose H2s carry the misregistered riso shadow. Never on text under 32px, never on body.

rules.name: The Text-Safe Rule
rules.body: Accent 500s are fills only. When an accent must be text, use its 800; links are Orchid 800. Text never sits on dots or overprints.

dos: Follow the **Shadow Rule**: solid = clickable, dots = static, nothing on stickers or the nav.
Keep dot layers behind **opaque** boxes; never put `mix-blend-mode` on a box that sits on dots.
Use accent 800s for any accent-colored text.
Keep content in Contentful (About, Work, Resume, Posts). Skills stay hardcoded.
Alternate tilt and dot ink between neighbors.
donts: Don't use accent 500s as text, put text on overprints or dots, or add a fourth spot ink.
Don't use Shrikhand under 24px, for body or labels, or the Ghost under 32px.
Don't use soft or blurred shadows, glassmorphism, or full-bleed colored section bands.
Don't bring back v1 pieces: Electric Pink, Fredoka, Cherry Bomb One, the stroked "hi!", the highlighter headline, the outline rings around the headshot, or the construction ticker.
Don't add a per-component grain layer.
